rules.description: Ensures all Medicare enrollee counts and reimbursement values are non-negative.
Verifies total Medicare enrollee count preserves historical HRR/HSA/county places (1999-2016) and refreshes through 2019.

params.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS NumStatVars, COALESCE(MIN(NumPlaces), 0) AS NumPlaces, COALESCE(MIN(NumObservations), 0) AS NumObservations, COALESCE(MIN(CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER)), 0) AS LatestDate FROM stats WHERE StatVar = 'Count_MedicareEnrollee'
params.condition: NumStatVars = 1 AND NumPlaces >= 5500 AND NumObservations >= 95000 AND LatestDate >= 2019

rules.description: Verifies price-adjusted Medicare reimbursement per enrollee coverage, minimum value scale (>= $1,000), and freshness through 2019.

params.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS NumStatVars, COALESCE(MIN(NumPlaces), 0) AS NumPlaces, COALESCE(MIN(NumObservations), 0) AS NumObservations, COALESCE(MIN(CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER)), 0) AS LatestDate, COALESCE(MIN(MinValue), 0) AS MinPrice FROM stats WHERE StatVar = 'dc/rn90czcrqcv06'
params.condition: NumStatVars = 1 AND NumPlaces >= 3000 AND NumObservations >= 45000 AND LatestDate >= 2019 AND MinPrice >= 1000

rules.description: Verifies historical Part A enrollee counts (Overall, Black, NonBlack) are preserved across 2007-2014.

params.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS NumStatVars, COALESCE(MIN(NumPlaces), 0) AS NumPlaces, COALESCE(MIN(NumObservations), 0) AS NumObservations, COALESCE(MIN(CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER)), 0) AS LatestDate FROM stats WHERE StatVar IN ('Count_MedicareEnrollee_MedicareA', 'Count_MedicareEnrollee_MedicareA_Black', 'Count_MedicareEnrollee_MedicareA_NonBlack')
params.condition: NumStatVars = 3 AND NumPlaces >= 1500 AND NumObservations >= 14000 AND LatestDate >= 2014

rules.description: Verifies Part B enrollee counts (Overall, Black, NonBlack) cover at least 1,500 places through 2019.

params.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS NumStatVars, COALESCE(MIN(NumPlaces), 0) AS NumPlaces, COALESCE(MIN(NumObservations), 0) AS NumObservations, COALESCE(MIN(CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER)), 0) AS LatestDate FROM stats WHERE StatVar IN ('Count_MedicareEnrollee_MedicareB', 'Count_MedicareEnrollee_MedicareB_Black', 'Count_MedicareEnrollee_MedicareB_NonBlack')
params.condition: NumStatVars = 3 AND NumPlaces >= 1500 AND NumObservations >= 15000 AND LatestDate >= 2019

rules.description: Verifies diabetic enrollee counts (Black, NonBlack) cover at least 1,200 places through 2019.

params.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS NumStatVars, COALESCE(MIN(NumPlaces), 0) AS NumPlaces, COALESCE(MIN(NumObservations), 0) AS NumObservations, COALESCE(MIN(CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER)), 0) AS LatestDate FROM stats WHERE StatVar IN ('Count_MedicareEnrollee_ConditionDiabetic_Black', 'Count_MedicareEnrollee_ConditionDiabetic_NonBlack')
params.condition: NumStatVars = 2 AND NumPlaces >= 1200 AND NumObservations >= 10000 AND LatestDate >= 2019
